prefill.chunked_path_validated: test_prefill_chunked_matches_hf and test_prefill_pipelined_matches_hf force small chunk sizes and reproduce HF (PCC>=0.995) at seq 1500 and 2048 for all layer kinds, incl. non-128/non-tile-aligned lengths.
prefill.long_prefill_mechanism: Prompts beyond ~8192 (single-shot Q/K/V activation exceeds DRAM: e.g. 64 heads * 128 * 262144 * 2 B = 4.3 GB for the sliding-layer Q alone) are processed as a sequence-pipelined stream of block-aligned chunks. Full-attention chunks attend over the paged cache (chunked SDPA); sliding chunks use a rolling window. Peak activation stays bounded to one chunk, so the full 262144 context prefills within DRAM. The public prefill API accepts any seq_len <= 262144.

decode.traced_execution_validated: test_decode_traced_pcc captures the decode graph once, then replays it over 4 steps updating input/cur_pos/rope_idx device tensors in place and compares each replayed output to HF at PCC>=0.995 (all 3 layer kinds). Proves traced correctness + cur_pos propagation, not just eager forward.
decode.value_weighting_note: Real-weight/real-input decode value-weighting (softmax over cached V) validated by test_decode_pcc at pos {32,513,2048}: PCC 0.99973-0.99999. Not directly PCC-checked with real semantics beyond 2048 (HF reference cost).

full_context_addressing.scope: Validates full-context cache fill/read, page-table over 8192 blocks, and int32 cur_pos + RoPE addressing at the advertised 262144 ONLY. Seeds varied K + ZERO cached V so the output direction equals the freshly-decoded token's value and PCC is invariant to the long-context softmax-weighting floor. This test does NOT validate value-weighting numerics at 262144.
full_context_addressing.synthetic_value_weighting_floor_measured: With nonzero constant cached V0 (isolates value-read over the full context) the full-attention 262143 decode measures PCC ~0.985-0.991 across seeds (sliding >0.995); this is the bf16-vs-fp32 accumulation floor for a near-uniform softmax over 262144 UNCORRELATED synthetic keys, not a decoder defect. Real activations produce peaked attention (validated at 2048: 0.9997).

multichip.target_mesh: Blackhole p300c x4, 1x4 mesh (P150x4), cluster_axis 1 = TP/EP axis, FABRIC_1D_RING
multichip.strategy: 1D tensor parallel (TP=4) for attention+dense; expert parallel (EP=4) for routed MoE; replicated residual with 2 all_reduce/layer
multichip.context_note: TP=4 + EP=4 INCREASE per-device headroom (they do not reduce capability): per-device KV cache is 1/4 (2 of 8 KV heads local) and per-device MoE expert weight is 1/4 (64 of 256 experts local). Advertised = supported = 262144, with more DRAM margin than single-chip.

per_device_kv_cache_bytes_full_context.calc: blocks_per_user=ceil(262144/32)=8192; k=[8192,2,32,128] bfp8 ~= 67MB; k+v ~= 134MB PER LAYER PER DEVICE (1 user). x40 layers = 5.4 GB/device.
per_device_kv_cache_bytes_full_context.single_chip_equivalent_per_layer: 8 KV heads -> ~537MB/layer -> 21.5 GB for 40 layers on one chip

per_device_moe_expert_bytes_per_layer.calc: 64 experts x 3 x (2048x512) params x ~0.5 B (bfp4) ~= 100MB/device/layer; 39 MoE layers = ~3.9 GB/device.
per_device_moe_expert_bytes_per_layer.single_chip_equivalent: 256 experts -> ~402MB/layer -> ~15.7 GB for 39 layers on one chip

multichip.full_model_fit: Per-device full-model footprint (40 layers, full 262144 ctx, 1 user) ~= 5.4 GB KV + 3.9 GB experts + ~0.5 GB attn/dense/norm weights + trace/activation ~= ~10 GB << 34.18 GB/chip. Single-chip full-model footprint (~21.5 GB KV + ~15.7 GB experts = ~37 GB) EXCEEDS 34.18 GB, so the 4-chip mesh is what makes the full 262144-context model fit; the decoder stage validates one layer at a time but the sharding is what enables the full stack.
multichip.validated: tests/test_multichip_decoder.py (vs HF, PCC>=0.995, all 3 layer kinds) + tests/mc_compare.py (vs single-chip TTNN optimized baseline, PCC>=0.9996 prefill+decode). Traced decode replay on the mesh validated (CCL + EP in-trace).
multichip.non_aligned_preserved: All sharding is on head/expert/hidden weight axes; none on the logical sequence. Prefill accepts any seq<=262144 (non-aligned 100/513/1500 pass); decode any cur_pos. No seq%k==0 public restriction.
multichip.optimized_multichip_note: optimized_multichip_decoder stage (tt/optimized_multichip_decoder.py) preserves this contract UNCHANGED: the only change is fusing SiLU into gate matmuls, which does not alter KV-cache dtype/layout (BFP8, local 2 KV heads), activation sharding, trace buffers, CCL buffers, or per-device weight/memory footprint. advertised = supported = 262144, capability_reduction none.

optimized.kv_cache_note: Optimized decoder changes the persistent paged KV-cache dtype from BF16 (functional) to BFP8. This HALVES cache bytes/token, so the advertised 262144 context still fits with more DRAM headroom — no capability reduction. Prefill fill tensors are cast to BFP8 before paged_fill_cache; decode paged_update_cache inputs stay BF16. Advertised = supported = 262144 for prefill and decode.
optimized.weight_dtype_policy: BF16 activations/norms; BFP8 attn(packed-QKV/O/gate)+dense-MLP+shared-expert weights (LoFi; gate HiFi2); BFP4 MoE routed-expert gate/up/down weights (LoFi); BF16 router (HiFi2). SDPA kept fp32/HiFi4 exp_approx=False for long-context accuracy.
optimized.validated: test_optimized_decoder.py — 65 passed / 0 failed at PCC>=0.995 (all 3 layer kinds), incl. test_full_context_decode at pos 262143 with the BFP8 cache (cache fill/read, page-table over 8192 blocks, int32 cur_pos + RoPE addressing). Decode PCC 0.9995-0.99999; prefill 0.9999.
optimized.non_aligned_preserved: Public prefill API still accepts any seq_len <= 262144 (non-128/non-tile-aligned included: seq 100/513/1500 pass); internal chunking/padding unchanged. No public seq_len % chunk == 0 restriction.

full_model.block_stack: 40x tt/optimized_multichip_decoder.py (OptimizedMultichipDecoder) on the 1x4 Blackhole p300c mesh (P150x4), FABRIC_1D_RING
full_model.layer_kinds: 10 full_attention + 30 sliding_attention; layer 0 dense MLP, layers 1-39 EP-sharded MoE (256 experts, 64 local/device, top-8, shared expert)
full_model.carried_forward_decoder_contract: UNCHANGED from the optimized multichip decoder: replicated BF16 inter-layer residual [1,seq,H]/[1,1,B,H] (NO inter-layer collective), 2 ring all_reduce/layer intra-layer, TP=4 attention/dense, EP=4 routed MoE (BFP4 experts, packed gate+up), local 2-KV-head BFP8 paged cache, BF16 activations/norms, BFP8 attn/dense/shared weights, HiFi2 router (BF16), precise fp32/HiFi4 SDPA. paged-cache dtype split (prefill fill cast to BFP8; decode paged_update_cache inputs BF16) preserved. rejection ledger (async/fused/persistent CCL, sharded residual, router/attention LoFi) preserved.
full_model.terminal_path_added: replicated token embedding [100352,2048] bf16; final RMSNorm on the replicated hidden (exact locally); COLUMN-SHARDED LM head [2048, 25088]/device bf16 so each device produces its own vocab shard; canonical split sampling (Sampling1D top-k(k=1) greedy) all-gathers only the 4x32 candidate set, NOT the 100352-wide vocab. No inter-layer collective added; terminal norm/LM-head/sampling localized to the last step.

per_device_weight_bytes_full_stack.calc: routed experts 39 MoE layers x 64 local x 3 x (2048x512) x 0.5B(BFP4) = 3.93 GB; attn(packed-QKV/O/gate)+dense+shared BFP8 (il+ds copies) ~0.55 GB; embed_tokens replicated [100352,2048] bf16 = 0.41 GB; LM head sharded [2048,25088] bf16 = 0.10 GB; RoPE tables (shared per kind: full rd=64 + sliding rd=128, cos+sin) = 0.20 GB. Total ~5.19 GB/device.

per_device_kv_cache_bytes_full_context.calc: 40 layers x ~134 MB/layer/device (local 2 KV heads, BFP8, blocks_per_user=ceil(262144/32)=8192, k+v) = 5.4 GB/device for 1 user at the full 262144 context (from the multichip decoder contract, x40 layers).

full_model.full_model_fit: Per-device full-model footprint at the full 262144 context, 1 user ~= 5.19 GB weights + 5.4 GB KV + ~1.5 GB trace/activation ~= ~12.1 GB << 34.18 GB/chip. The 4-chip mesh is what makes the full 262144-context model fit (single-chip weights+KV ~= 37 GB exceeds 34.18 GB). Runtime-VERIFIED: the full 40-layer model builds and runs prefill+traced decode on the mesh (tests/smoke_full_model.py; build ~380 s one-time, then generation). Full-context (262144) fit is analytic from the per-layer decoder numbers x40 (the decoder stage validated full-context single-layer addressing at pos 262143); runtime accuracy is validated at the readiness prompt length (prompt 192 + gen 100).
full_model.prompt_length_contract: The public generator accepts any prompt length up to 262144, including non-tile/non-block-aligned lengths (the decoder chunks/pads internally: single-shot <=8192, sequence-pipelined beyond; MoE prefill chunked at 256). No seq%k==0 public restriction. Smoke uses non-aligned prompt length 100.
full_model.batch_contract: batch-1 single-user is the primary latency path; the low-level prefill_forward/decode_forward and cache/page-table/positions are batch-general (decoder validated batch up to 32 with permuted page tables). Traced generate runs batch-1; larger-batch traced decode is exposed through the same low-level API for vLLM.
full_model.validated: tests/probe_full_model.py (terminal/sampling shapes), tests/probe_generate.py + tests/smoke_full_model.py (traced device split-sampling == host argmax control), tests/test_split_sampling_trace.py (feedback/position/page-table), tests/full_model_checks.py (prefill + teacher-forcing top-k vs AIME24 reference, autoregressive).

optimized_full_model.delta_vs_full_model: The ONLY change vs the full_model stage is the column-sharded LM-head weight dtype: BF16 -> BFP8 (LagunaModel.from_pretrained lm_head_dtype default now ttnn.bfloat8_b; pass ttnn.bfloat16 for the stage-05 baseline). The LM head is the largest DRAM-bound terminal matmul (32x2048x25088, 73.8% DRAM util, 98 cores); halving its weight bytes is the one material full-model-only decode lever. Everything else on the terminal + orchestration path was measured already-optimal (logits-only decode at the decoder-layer-stack floor; sampler <1%).

lm_head_dram_bytes_per_device.calc: column-sharded LM head [2048,25088]/device: bf16 ~0.10 GB -> bfp8 ~0.05 GB. Per-device full-stack weights ~5.19 GB -> ~5.14 GB; full-model fit headroom improves (still ~12 GB << 34.18 GB/chip).

kv_cache_capacity_analysis.effect_on_capacity: none - KV-cache dtype/layout is identical to the optimized_full_model stage, so per-device KV bytes/context and the advertised 262144 context are unchanged (per-device KV ~5.4 GB at 262144, 1 user; full-model footprint ~12.1 GB << 34.18 GB/chip).

kv_dtype_candidates_evaluated.bfloat16 (C1, evaluated, REJECTED): would DOUBLE per-device KV to ~10.8 GB @262144 (full-model ~17.5 GB, still < 34.18 GB/chip so 262144 would STILL fit) but gives identical full-model accuracy (top1 0.95) and identical decode t/s/u while using 2x the cache memory -> rejected; not selected, so no capacity recompute needed for it. Recorded here for completeness: even the higher-memory BF16 KV candidate would not have reduced the advertised 262144 capability.
kv_dtype_candidates_evaluated.bfloat4_b: not evaluated (would INCREASE capacity headroom, not reduce it; high accuracy risk on long-context value-weighting; decode KV-read is a small fraction of decode at batch-1 so no material perf win expected). Not selected.

kv_cache_capacity_analysis.recompute_note: The selected KV-cache dtype (BFP8) does not change memory capacity vs the prior stage, so the advertised/supported context remains 262144 with capability_reduction none. No advertised capability was lowered by the sweep.

datatype_sweep.perf: See doc/datatype_sweep/ (sweep_results.json/csv, README.md). Selected config == optimized_full_model baseline: warmed batch-1 prompt128/gen128 token-out ~30.3 t/s/u (post_selection.json), teacher-forcing traced decode ~26 t/s/u, top1 0.95 / top5 1.00 / top100 1.00.
datatype_sweep.note: The sweep found NO lower-precision/lower-fidelity config faster than the baseline beyond a +/-0.7% token-out measurement-noise band, because decode is dominated by the already-BFP4 routed-expert matmuls; several lower-precision moves cost top-1. Baseline retained. Selecting a lower-precision config would not have changed capacity (KV dtype unchanged).
